generic.Defined scope/population: Risks rated by first line in the current RCSA cycle for this business unit.
generic.In-scope period: Current RCSA assessment cycle from workshop kickoff to committee sign-off.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Challenge comment, disputed-rating flag, and reviewer name for each risk.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of risks challenged matches count of risks rated by first line.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Challenge notes timestamped in the GRC platform's RCSA workbook history.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Disputed ratings routed back to risk owner with resolution recorded.
generic.Test population: All key risks rated by the first line pending second-line challenge.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when every key risk carries at least one second-line challenge note.
generic.Exception handling path: Disputed scores route to the risk owner for re-rating before sign-off.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Workflow status moves to Second Line Reviewed only after challenge is complete.
generic.Evidence location: RCSA workbook record in the GRC platform, challenge notes tab.

steps.title: Open the RCSA workbook and filter to pending challenges
sop: Open the RCSA workbook in the GRC platform.
Filter risks to status 'Pending 2nd Line Challenge'.
Confirm the filtered list matches the risks rated this cycle.
Done when the pending-challenge list is confirmed complete.
verify: Compare the filtered count to the first-line rated risk count.
Pass when the two counts match exactly.

steps.title: Record challenge comments against each risk rating
sop: Review the first-line inherent and residual risk ratings for each risk.
Enter a challenge comment in the GRC platform for each rating reviewed.
Note agreement or disagreement with the proposed rating.
Done when every risk in scope has a challenge comment logged.
verify: Spot-check five risk records for a logged challenge comment.
Pass when all five show a comment with a reviewer name.

steps.title: Flag disputed risk scores and route to risk owner
sop: Identify any inherent or residual score the second line disputes.
Set the dispute flag on the risk record in the GRC platform.
Route the disputed record back to the risk owner with rationale.
Done when every disputed score is flagged and routed.
verify: Check the GRC platform's routed-items queue for disputed risks.
Pass when each disputed risk shows a routed status to its owner.

steps.title: Confirm risk owner responses to disputed ratings
sop: Follow up with each risk owner on a routed disputed rating.
Record the risk owner's revised rating or justification in Confluence.
Attach the response to the RCSA workbook risk record.
Done when every disputed rating has a recorded owner response.
verify: Review the RCSA workbook for outstanding disputed items.
Pass when no disputed rating remains without an owner response.

steps.title: Verify at least one challenge note per key risk
sop: Run the GRC platform's challenge-completeness report for the cycle.
Confirm each key risk shows one or more logged challenge notes.
Log any key risk missing a challenge note as an exception.
Done when the completeness report shows zero missing notes.
verify: Review the completeness report output.
Pass when zero key risks are missing a challenge note.

steps.title: Update RCSA workflow status to Second Line Reviewed
sop: Confirm all challenge notes and disputes are resolved or routed.
Update the RCSA record's workflow status field in the GRC platform.
Set the status to Second Line Reviewed.
Done when the status update is saved and visible on the record.
verify: Reopen the RCSA record and check the workflow status field.
Pass when the status reads Second Line Reviewed.

steps.title: Notify Compliance Analyst of completed challenge
sop: Post a status update in Confluence summarizing the challenge outcome.
Tag the Compliance Analyst for awareness before sign-off routing.
Attach the challenge-completeness report to the update.
Done when the Confluence update is published and tagged.
verify: Check Confluence for the published update and tag.
Pass when the Compliance Analyst is tagged on the update.

generic.Defined scope/population: Risk owners whose processes are in scope for the current RCSA workshop cycle.
generic.In-scope period: From scope notification date to the scheduled workshop start date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Distribution list, workshop dates, and required pre-work per risk owner.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of notifications sent matches count of in-scope risk owners.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Notification log entry timestamped in the GRC platform per risk owner.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Non-acknowledging risk owners logged as an exception and followed up.
generic.Test population: All risk owners assigned to processes selected for this cycle's workshop.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when every in-scope risk owner has a logged, acknowledged notification.
generic.Exception handling path: Non-acknowledgment after two business days triggers a direct follow-up call.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Notification counted complete only once acknowledgment is logged.
generic.Evidence location: RCSA workbook notification log in the GRC platform.

steps.title: Generate the risk-owner distribution list from the RCSA workbook
sop: Open the RCSA workbook's assigned-owner field for in-scope processes.
Export the list of risk owners and their contact details.
Cross-check the list against the current org chart in SharePoint.
Done when the distribution list is exported and verified.
verify: Compare the exported list count to the in-scope process count.
Pass when every in-scope process has a named risk owner.

steps.title: Draft the scope notification identifying processes and pre-work
sop: List in-scope processes, workshop dates, and required pre-work.
Draft the notification email using the RCSA scope template in SharePoint.
Have the Operational Risk Manager review the draft for completeness.
Done when the draft is approved for distribution.
verify: Check the draft against the RCSA workbook scope list.
Pass when every in-scope process appears in the notification.

steps.title: Attach the prior-cycle risk register as reference material
sop: Pull the prior-cycle RCSA risk register export from the GRC platform.
Attach the register to the scope notification as reference.
Confirm the attached file matches the correct prior cycle.
Done when the reference attachment is confirmed correct.
verify: Open the attachment and check the cycle date in the header.
Pass when the attached register matches the immediately prior cycle.

steps.title: Send the scope notification to all risk owners
sop: Send the notification and attachment to the full distribution list.
Copy the Operational Risk Manager and Compliance Analyst.
Log the send timestamp in the GRC platform notification log.
Done when the notification log shows a sent entry for every owner.
verify: Check the notification log for a sent timestamp per owner.
Pass when every risk owner shows a sent entry.

steps.title: Track acknowledgment receipt in the notification log
sop: Monitor incoming acknowledgments against the distribution list.
Record each acknowledgment date in the GRC platform notification log.
Follow up directly with any owner not acknowledging within two days.
Done when every risk owner's acknowledgment status is current.
verify: Run the notification log report for outstanding acknowledgments.
Pass when zero risk owners remain unacknowledged past the deadline.

steps.title: Escalate non-responsive risk owners to Operational Risk Manager
sop: Identify risk owners with no acknowledgment after follow-up.
Notify the Operational Risk Manager of the non-response.
Request the Operational Risk Manager's help securing acknowledgment.
Done when the escalation is logged and closed with a response.
verify: Check the notification log for closure of escalated items.
Pass when all escalated risk owners show a final acknowledgment.

generic.Defined scope/population: All inherent risks captured in the current-cycle RCSA workbook.
generic.In-scope period: Current RCSA workshop cycle from risk identification through control mapping.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Control owner, frequency, control type, and linked evidence source per control.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of controls documented matches count of inherent risks requiring coverage.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Control record timestamped and versioned in the GRC platform on save.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Risks with zero linked controls logged as a control gap in the register.
generic.Test population: Every inherent risk identified in the current RCSA workshop.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when each inherent risk has at least one control record populated.
generic.Exception handling path: Zero-control risks route to the control-gap remediation queue.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Control frequency must match the operating cadence observed in the workshop.
generic.Evidence location: Control register within the RCSA workbook in the GRC platform.

steps.title: Add a control record for each inherent risk in the RCSA workbook
sop: Open each inherent risk record in the RCSA workbook.
Add a control record with control owner, frequency, and type.
Select preventive or detective as the control type.
Done when every inherent risk has an associated control record.
verify: Query the RCSA workbook for risks without a control record.
Pass when the query returns zero unmapped risks.

steps.title: Link each control to its supporting evidence source
sop: Identify the evidence source for each control (approval log, reconciliation).
Attach or reference the evidence source in the control record.
Confirm the Controls Analyst agrees the evidence source is appropriate.
Done when every control record cites a specific evidence source.
verify: Sample five control records for a populated evidence-source field.
Pass when all five cite a specific, named evidence source.

steps.title: Confirm control frequency matches observed operating cadence
sop: Compare the recorded control frequency to the cadence observed in the workshop.
Correct any mismatch between recorded and actual frequency.
Note the correction rationale in the control record.
Done when recorded frequency matches the observed cadence for every control.
verify: Spot-check control frequency against workshop notes for five controls.
Pass when all five match the observed cadence.

steps.title: Flag risks with zero linked controls as control gaps
sop: Run the RCSA workbook report for risks with no linked control.
Tag each result as a control gap in the register.
Assign the gap for remediation-action creation.
Done when every zero-control risk is tagged as a gap.
verify: Re-run the zero-control report after tagging.
Pass when every flagged risk shows the control-gap tag.

steps.title: Review control register completeness with Compliance Analyst
sop: Review the completed control register against the RCSA risk list.
Confirm control type, owner, and frequency fields are all populated.
Note any incomplete record back to the Risk Analyst for correction.
Done when the Compliance Analyst confirms the register is complete.
verify: Check the register for any blank owner, frequency, or type field.
Pass when zero blank fields remain across the control register.

steps.title: Publish the finalized control register to SharePoint
sop: Export the finalized control register from the GRC platform.
Upload the export to the RCSA cycle folder in SharePoint.
Confirm access permissions match the RCSA distribution group.
Done when the register is published and accessible to the group.
verify: Open the SharePoint folder and confirm the file is present.
Pass when the published register matches the GRC platform export.

generic.Defined scope/population: First-line process owners and risks/controls discussed in the scheduled workshop.
generic.In-scope period: The single scheduled control-mapping workshop session for the in-scope process.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Attendee names, identified risks, and candidate controls per process.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of processes walked through matches processes scoped for the workshop.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Workshop minutes and RCSA workbook entries timestamped at session close.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Risks raised outside the RCSA taxonomy logged for taxonomy review.
generic.Test population: All in-scope processes and their first-line owners scheduled for the workshop.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when every in-scope process has captured risks and candidate controls.
generic.Exception handling path: Out-of-taxonomy risks route to the taxonomy review backlog, not the register.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Workshop output summary must be distributed within two business days.
generic.Evidence location: Workshop minutes and RCSA workbook entries in the GRC platform and Confluence.

steps.title: Walk first-line owners through the process and risk taxonomy
sop: Present the process and risk taxonomy for the in-scope area.
Confirm each first-line owner recognizes their process boundaries.
Answer clarifying questions before risk identification begins.
Done when all attendees confirm the taxonomy walkthrough is understood.
verify: Poll attendees for confirmation at the end of the walkthrough.
Pass when every attendee confirms understanding.

steps.title: Capture identified risks and candidate controls in the RCSA workbook
sop: Enter each risk raised during the session into the RCSA workbook live.
Record the candidate control proposed for each risk.
Confirm the process owner agrees with the captured wording.
Done when every raised risk and control is entered in the workbook.
verify: Count workbook entries against the session's discussion notes.
Pass when the entry count matches the risks discussed.

steps.title: Record workshop attendance and sign-in
sop: Circulate the sign-in sheet at the start of the session.
Record attendee names and roles in the workshop minutes.
Note any invited attendee who did not join.
Done when attendance is fully recorded in the minutes.
verify: Compare the sign-in sheet to the minutes attendee list.
Pass when the two lists match exactly.

steps.title: Log out-of-taxonomy risks for taxonomy review
sop: Identify risks raised that fall outside the RCSA taxonomy.
Log each in the taxonomy review backlog with the raising attendee's name.
Confirm the risk is excluded from the current-cycle register.
Done when all out-of-taxonomy risks are logged in the backlog.
verify: Check the taxonomy backlog for the logged items.
Pass when every out-of-scope risk raised appears in the backlog.

steps.title: Distribute the workshop output summary to attendees
sop: Compile the session's risks, controls, and open items into a summary.
Post the summary in Confluence and email it to attendees.
Confirm distribution occurs within two business days of the session.
Done when the summary is distributed within the two-day window.
verify: Check the Confluence post date against the workshop date.
Pass when the post date is within two business days.

steps.title: Confirm RCSA workbook entries reconcile to workshop minutes
sop: Compare the RCSA workbook entries against the finalized minutes.
Correct any discrepancy in risk or control wording.
Confirm the Operational Risk Manager signs off on the reconciliation.
Done when workbook and minutes match with sign-off recorded.
verify: Review the workbook and minutes side by side.
Pass when all entries match and sign-off is recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: Controls rated Ineffective or Not Designed in the current RCSA cycle.
generic.In-scope period: Current RCSA cycle from control-rating completion through remediation logging.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Remediation owner, target closure date, and priority per action.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of remediation actions matches count of controls rated deficient.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Remediation action record timestamped on creation in the GRC platform.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Actions without an assigned owner logged as an exception and escalated.
generic.Test population: Every control rated Ineffective or Not Designed in the current cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when each deficient control has one linked remediation action.
generic.Exception handling path: Unassigned actions route to the Operational Risk Manager for owner assignment.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Remediation action must link back to the specific risk and control record.
generic.Evidence location: Remediation tracker in the GRC platform, linked to the RCSA workbook.

steps.title: Identify controls rated Ineffective or Not Designed
sop: Run the RCSA workbook report filtered to deficient control ratings.
Confirm the filtered list reflects the finalized rating cycle.
Export the list of deficient controls for action creation.
Done when the deficient-control list is confirmed and exported.
verify: Cross-check the exported list against the control register.
Pass when the counts match exactly.

steps.title: Create a remediation action record for each deficient control
sop: Open the GRC platform's remediation-action creation form.
Create one action record per deficient control identified.
Link the action to its parent risk and control record.
Done when every deficient control has a corresponding action record.
verify: Query the GRC platform for deficient controls without an action.
Pass when the query returns zero unlinked deficient controls.

steps.title: Assign a remediation owner and target closure date
sop: Identify the accountable owner for each remediation action.
Enter the owner and a target closure date on the action record.
Confirm the Controls Analyst agrees the target date is realistic.
Done when every action has an owner and target date populated.
verify: Sample five action records for owner and date fields.
Pass when all five show a named owner and a future target date.

steps.title: Set action priority based on associated residual risk rating
sop: Pull the residual risk rating linked to each remediation action.
Set the action priority (high/medium/low) to match the residual rating.
Flag any high-residual action for expedited tracking.
Done when every action's priority reflects its residual risk rating.
verify: Compare action priority against linked residual ratings for five items.
Pass when all five priorities match the linked residual rating.

steps.title: Route remediation actions to the ITSM platform for tracking
sop: Create a linked ticket in the ITSM platform for each remediation action.
Confirm the ticket references the GRC platform action ID.
Set the ticket due date to match the target closure date.
Done when every remediation action has a linked ITSM ticket.
verify: Check the ITSM platform for a ticket per remediation action.
Pass when every action shows a linked, open ticket.

steps.title: Confirm remediation tracker completeness before cycle close
sop: Run the remediation tracker completeness report for the cycle.
Confirm every deficient control shows a linked, owned action.
Escalate any gap to the Operational Risk Manager.
Done when the completeness report shows zero gaps.
verify: Review the completeness report output.
Pass when zero deficient controls remain without a remediation action.

generic.Defined scope/population: Finalized RCSA record for the business unit completing this cycle.
generic.In-scope period: Current RCSA cycle from challenge completion through committee submission.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Business unit head name, title, and sign-off date on the record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of RCSA records routed matches count of finalized records.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed attestation timestamped and attached to the RCSA record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Records with unresolved challenge comments logged and not routed.
generic.Test population: Every finalized RCSA record awaiting business unit head sign-off.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when the signed attestation is attached with name, title, and date.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved challenge comments block routing until resolved by the risk owner.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Sign-off must be captured before submission to the risk committee.
generic.Evidence location: RCSA record's sign-off tab in the GRC platform.

steps.title: Verify no open challenge comments remain on the RCSA record
sop: Open the RCSA record and review the challenge comments tab.
Confirm every challenge comment shows a resolved status.
Follow up with the Risk Analyst on any unresolved comment.
Done when zero unresolved challenge comments remain.
verify: Re-check the challenge comments tab after follow-up.
Pass when every comment shows a resolved status.

steps.title: Route the finalized RCSA record for business unit sign-off
sop: Open the GRC platform's sign-off routing workflow.
Select the business unit head as the required approver.
Submit the record into the electronic sign-off queue.
Done when the record shows a pending sign-off status.
verify: Check the GRC platform's routing queue for the record.
Pass when the record shows pending sign-off with the correct approver.

steps.title: Confirm the sign-off captures name, title, and date
sop: Wait for the business unit head to complete the electronic sign-off.
Check the sign-off entry for name, title, and sign-off date.
Follow up if any required field is missing.
Done when name, title, and date are all populated.
verify: Open the completed sign-off entry.
Pass when name, title, and date fields are all present.

steps.title: Attach the signed attestation to the RCSA record
sop: Export the signed attestation confirmation from the GRC platform.
Attach the export to the RCSA record's documentation tab.
Confirm the attachment opens correctly and is legible.
Done when the attestation is attached and verified legible.
verify: Open the attached attestation from the record.
Pass when the document is legible and correctly dated.

steps.title: Notify Enterprise Risk Manager of completed sign-off
sop: Post a notification in SharePoint confirming sign-off completion.
Tag the Enterprise Risk Manager for awareness.
Attach the reference to the signed RCSA record.
Done when the notification is posted and tagged.
verify: Check SharePoint for the posted notification and tag.
Pass when the Enterprise Risk Manager is tagged on the update.

steps.title: Confirm the cycle-end acceptance criterion is satisfied
sop: Pull the final output for this cycle from its system of record.
Check the cycle output against the criterion: business unit head sign-off recorded with date prior to committee submission
Log any exception found during this final check with its disposition.
Done when the criterion is confirmed met or exceptions are logged.
verify: Review the final check results against the acceptance criterion.
Pass when the criterion is met or every exception has a logged disposition.

generic.Defined scope/population: Finalized risk register, ratings, and remediation actions for the current cycle.
generic.In-scope period: Current RCSA cycle from sign-off completion through committee submission.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Risk register, heat map, sign-off record, and open actions in the pack.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Pack figures reconcile to the live RCSA workbook export for the cycle.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Attestation pack version and export timestamp recorded in SharePoint.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Discrepancies between pack and workbook logged and corrected before routing.
generic.Test population: The finalized attestation pack for the current RCSA cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when pack figures match the RCSA workbook export exactly.
generic.Exception handling path: Discrepancies route back to the Risk Analyst for correction before review.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Pack must be reviewed and approved by the Operational Risk Manager first.
generic.Evidence location: Attestation pack file in the RCSA cycle folder in SharePoint.

steps.title: Compile the risk register and control ratings into the pack template
sop: Open the attestation pack template in SharePoint.
Populate the risk register and control ratings from the RCSA workbook.
Insert the residual risk heat map generated in Power BI.
Done when the register, ratings, and heat map are all inserted.
verify: Review the populated template sections for completeness.
Pass when register, ratings, and heat map are all present.

steps.title: Include sign-off record and open remediation actions in the pack
sop: Pull the business unit sign-off record from the GRC platform.
Pull the open remediation-action summary from the remediation tracker.
Insert both into the designated pack sections.
Done when sign-off record and open actions both appear in the pack.
verify: Check the pack for both the sign-off record and action summary.
Pass when both sections are present and correctly dated.

steps.title: Cross-check pack figures against the live RCSA workbook export
sop: Export the current RCSA workbook data from the GRC platform.
Compare risk counts, ratings, and action counts to the pack.
Correct any discrepancy found in the pack.
Done when pack figures match the workbook export exactly.
verify: Re-run the comparison after corrections.
Pass when zero discrepancies remain between pack and export.

steps.title: Route the draft pack for Operational Risk Manager review
sop: Save the draft pack to the RCSA cycle folder in SharePoint.
Notify the Operational Risk Manager the draft is ready for review.
Incorporate any review comments received.
Done when the Operational Risk Manager approves the draft.
verify: Check SharePoint for the Operational Risk Manager's approval comment.
Pass when the approval is recorded on the draft.

steps.title: Finalize and archive the attestation pack
sop: Apply the Operational Risk Manager's approved changes to the pack.
Mark the pack version as Final in SharePoint.
Archive the final pack in the RCSA cycle folder for committee submission.
Done when the final pack is archived and marked Final.
verify: Open the archived pack and check the version label.
Pass when the version label reads Final.

steps.title: Confirm the cycle-end acceptance criterion is satisfied
sop: Pull the final output for this cycle from its system of record.
Check the cycle output against the documented acceptance criterion for this task.
Log any exception found during this final check with its disposition.
Done when the criterion is confirmed met or exceptions are logged.
verify: Review the final check results against the acceptance criterion.
Pass when the criterion is met or every exception has a logged disposition.

generic.Defined scope/population: Controls documented in the RCSA workbook for the current cycle.
generic.In-scope period: Current RCSA cycle covering design and operating-effectiveness ratings.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Design rating, effectiveness rating, and supporting testing evidence per control.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of rated controls matches count of controls documented this cycle.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Rating and evidence attachment timestamped on save in the GRC platform.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Controls rated Ineffective flagged for automatic remediation-action creation.
generic.Test population: Every control documented in the current-cycle RCSA workbook.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when each control has a design and effectiveness rating with evidence.
generic.Exception handling path: Ineffective ratings auto-route to remediation-action creation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Rating changes from the prior cycle must include a documented rationale.
generic.Evidence location: Control rating fields within the RCSA workbook in the GRC platform.

steps.title: Assess control design adequacy against the mitigated risk
sop: Review each control's design against the risk it is meant to mitigate.
Assign a design rating of Effective, Partially Effective, or Ineffective.
Note the rationale for the assigned design rating.
Done when every control has a documented design rating.
verify: Sample five control records for a populated design rating.
Pass when all five show a rating and rationale.

steps.title: Attach testing evidence supporting the effectiveness rating
sop: Gather sample size and exceptions-found data from control testing.
Attach the testing evidence to the control's effectiveness rating.
Confirm the evidence supports the assigned operating-effectiveness rating.
Done when every rated control has attached testing evidence.
verify: Open five rated controls and check for attached evidence.
Pass when all five show testing evidence matching the rating.

steps.title: Record rationale where a rating differs from the prior cycle
sop: Compare the current rating to the prior-cycle rating for each control.
Document the rationale for any rating change identified.
Have the Risk Analyst confirm the rationale is adequately supported.
Done when every rating change has a documented rationale.
verify: Check controls with changed ratings for a rationale entry.
Pass when every changed rating has a supporting rationale.

steps.title: Flag Ineffective controls for automatic remediation-action creation
sop: Run the GRC platform's automated flag for Ineffective-rated controls.
Confirm each flagged control triggers a remediation-action creation.
Verify the triggered action links back to the correct control record.
Done when every Ineffective control has a triggered remediation action.
verify: Query the remediation tracker for linked actions on Ineffective controls.
Pass when every Ineffective control shows a linked action.

steps.title: Confirm ratings and evidence are complete before sign-off routing
sop: Run the RCSA workbook completeness check for design and effectiveness ratings.
Confirm every control shows both ratings and attached evidence.
Escalate any incomplete control record to the Controls Analyst.
Done when the completeness check shows zero gaps.
verify: Review the completeness check output.
Pass when zero controls are missing a rating or evidence.

steps.title: Confirm the cycle-end acceptance criterion is satisfied
sop: Pull the final output for this cycle from its system of record.
Check the cycle output against the documented acceptance criterion for this task.
Log any exception found during this final check with its disposition.
Done when the criterion is confirmed met or exceptions are logged.
verify: Review the final check results against the acceptance criterion.
Pass when the criterion is met or every exception has a logged disposition.

generic.Defined scope/population: Risks with a finalized inherent score and control-effectiveness rating.
generic.In-scope period: Current RCSA cycle from control rating completion through residual scoring.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Residual risk score and appetite-breach flag per risk record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of residual scores recorded matches count of rated risks.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Residual rating timestamped on save in the RCSA workbook.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Risks exceeding appetite flagged as a breach and routed for escalation.
generic.Test population: Every risk with a finalized inherent score and control rating this cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when every risk has a residual score and correct breach flag.
generic.Exception handling path: Appetite breaches route to the Operational Risk Manager for escalation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Residual score must combine inherent score with control effectiveness.
generic.Evidence location: Residual risk field within the RCSA workbook risk record in the GRC platform.

steps.title: Combine inherent score with aggregate control effectiveness
sop: Pull the inherent risk score for each risk from the RCSA workbook.
Pull the aggregate control-effectiveness rating for linked controls.
Apply the residual-scoring formula to derive the residual score.
Done when a residual score is calculated for every risk.
verify: Recalculate five residual scores independently.
Pass when all five match the recorded score.

steps.title: Compare residual scores against board-approved appetite thresholds
sop: Pull the risk-appetite threshold for each risk's category from Power BI.
Compare the residual score against the corresponding threshold.
Note the utilization percentage against the threshold.
Done when every risk's score is compared to its threshold.
verify: Spot-check five comparisons against the appetite reference table.
Pass when all five comparisons use the correct threshold.

steps.title: Flag risks exceeding appetite as a breach requiring escalation
sop: Identify risks whose residual score exceeds the appetite threshold.
Set the breach flag on each identified risk record.
Notify the Operational Risk Manager of each new breach.
Done when every over-threshold risk shows the breach flag set.
verify: Query the RCSA workbook for over-threshold risks without a flag.
Pass when the query returns zero unflagged breaches.

steps.title: Record residual rating and breach flag in the RCSA workbook
sop: Enter the residual risk rating into the risk record.
Enter the breach flag status alongside the rating.
Confirm both fields save correctly in the GRC platform.
Done when both fields are saved and visible on the record.
verify: Reopen the risk record and check both fields.
Pass when the rating and flag match the calculated values.

steps.title: Confirm Operational Risk Manager reviews flagged breaches
sop: Review the list of newly flagged appetite breaches.
Confirm each breach is routed to the escalation workflow.
Note any breach requiring immediate committee attention.
Done when every breach is confirmed routed for escalation.
verify: Check the escalation workflow queue for the flagged breaches.
Pass when every flagged breach appears in the queue.

steps.title: Confirm the cycle-end acceptance criterion is satisfied
sop: Pull the final output for this cycle from its system of record.
Check the cycle output against the documented acceptance criterion for this task.
Log any exception found during this final check with its disposition.
Done when the criterion is confirmed met or exceptions are logged.
verify: Review the final check results against the acceptance criterion.
Pass when the criterion is met or every exception has a logged disposition.

generic.Defined scope/population: RCSA results and risk profile changes for the current reporting cycle.
generic.In-scope period: Current cycle results through the scheduled Operational Risk Committee meeting.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Risk profile changes, heat map, and remediation status in the committee pack.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Pack figures reconcile to the RCSA workbook export as of the cutoff.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Committee pack and minutes timestamped and filed after the meeting.
